s: This article details the integration of Unix pipe philosophy into web workflows using HTMX and FastHTML. It focuses on consistent display of side effects, refining user interface flow to mirror pipe input-output behavior, and establishing common conventions for workflow management.
sub: AI prompting strategies (storytelling vs. prompt engineering)
Unix pipe metaphor for UI/workflow design (input/output consistency)
HTMX for dynamic web interfaces (card behavior, side effects)
Workflow conventions (revert, lock, parity across tools)
